This programme provides students with comprehensive knowledge and practical skills in Anthropology. Through a blend of theory and hands-on learning, students develop the analytical, technical, and professional competencies required to excel in Anthropology-related careers. Graduates are equipped to apply current best practice, engage critically with developments in the field, and contribute meaningfully to their communities and professions. / program Objectives: Equip students with a strong conceptual and practical foundation in Anthropology. Foster ethical, inclusive, and socially responsible professional conduct. / learning Outcomes: Demonstrate a sound understanding of core concepts and methods in Anthropology. Apply relevant theories and techniques to real-world Anthropology challenges. Communicate effectively in professional and multidisciplinary settings. Work collaboratively and independently on Anthropology-related tasks and projects. / career Opportunities: Graduates of this programme are prepared for roles in government, non-governmental organisations, private sector firms, and academia. setting Key: about_founding_story / setting Value: Our institute was founded after witnessing firsthand the cycle of poverty trapping single mothers and vulnerable youth in our community — not because of lack of ability, but lack of opportunity and skills. The founder, a community leader and educator, believed that practical vocational training — not charity — was the most dignified path to self-sufficiency. A small rented space, three sewing machines, and twelve students became the beginning of something far greater. Today, hundreds of graduates are running their own businesses, supporting their families, and transforming their communities — one skill at a time.
